items.title: ABHI UK HealthTech Conference 2026, London, 9 to 10 November
items.summary: ABHI's flagship two-day conference runs 9 to 10 November 2026 at the Cavendish Conference Centre, London. Day one covers regulation, MHRA early engagement, AI oversight and post-market surveillance. Day two covers market access and adoption, NICE and NHS access pathways, local system adoption and procurement.

items.title: HETT Show 2026, ExCeL London, 29 to 30 September
items.summary: HETT, Healthcare Excellence Through Technology, runs at ExCeL London on 29 and 30 September 2026. It draws NHS, local government and social care digital and clinical staff, with roughly 3,000 attendees, 250 speakers and 150 supplier exhibitors.

items.title: NHS England awards Netcompany £215m screening deal
items.summary: NHS England has selected Copenhagen-based Netcompany to run and enhance the digital services behind existing screening pathways, including a new national breast screening system, as part of a £215m award.

items.title: ABHI Digital Health Conference 2026, London, 7 October
items.summary: ABHI's Digital Health Conference takes place on Wednesday 7 October 2026, 09:30 to 18:30, at Covington and Burling LLP in London, covering digital health regulation, adoption and commercial routes for UK healthtech.

items.title: HTN Now: How Enterprise Content Management can quickly and easily help your digital journey
items.summary: For a recent HTN Now webinar, we were joined by James Williams, diagnostic imaging and ECM specialist at Dedalus, to discuss how an Enterprise Content Management (ECM) strategy can support healthcare organisations in their journeys toward digital transformation.

items.summary: Oracle has introduced an oncology EHR, reportedly offering access to built-in AI agents and clinical decision support, intended to connect results, decision making, and action across the cancer care pathway.

items.title: Norfolk and Suffolk ICB notes significant outcomes with preventative interventions
items.summary: Norfolk and Suffolk ICB has published details of its digital weight management programme, highlighting the contribution of a population health management approach to achieving “significant” outcomes.

items.title: EMIS rebrands as Enlivio Health
items.summary: EMIS has rebranded as Enlivio Health, announcing an “exciting new era” following a strategy refresh, the introduction of new leadership, and a renewed focus on improving pace and consistency across product and development teams.

items.title: What does the future of EPRs look like? Join us for HTN Now 30 September
items.summary: What does the future of EPRs look like? We’ll debate this question with a panel of experts 30 September as part of the HTN Now webinar series.

items.title: Wales opens innovation procurements to tackle missed appointments and modernise bowel screening pathways
